purpose: Teach: 無くなる/しっくり/どうこう/さび/インチキ/かろうじて/よけい/おわり

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店のコーヒー豆、無くなる前に発注しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's order the coffee beans before we run out.
lines.style: Calm, practical suggestion. Leaning forward slightly, matter-of-fact. No urgency—just thinking ahead together. Warm attentiveness in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューがしっくりきたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new menu items are really working, Mei.
lines.style: Genuine pride in the voice. A soft smile underneath. Speaking clearly, with quiet conviction. The satisfaction of something landing right.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様が他のお店をどうこう言われると嫌よね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It bothers me when customers complain about other cafés.
lines.style: Dry, understated. A slight edge of weariness beneath. Speaking to an understanding friend, not complaining—just naming something true. Brief pause before speaking.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の壁にさびが出てきたね、メイちゃん
lines.en: There's rust forming on the shop wall.
lines.style: Quiet observation. Thoughtful, slightly worried undertone. Speaking as if noticing something small that matters. Soft, measured pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、インチキな広告に騙されないよう注意しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should be careful not to fall for those fake advertisements.
lines.style: Gentle guidance with quiet conviction. Speaking as someone looking out for them both. No lecturing—just looking ahead. Steady, protective tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、かろうじて閉店時間に間に合ったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: We just barely made it by closing time.
lines.style: Slight laugh of relief underneath. Breathless, like they've just caught their breath. Wry acknowledgment of a close call. Quick, light delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、よけいなご注文は避けるようにしてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I try to avoid taking on extra orders.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. A hint of self-care underneath—not defensive, just honest about limits. Speaking gently but with quiet clarity. Even pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、今日のお仕事のおわりに乾杯しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's toast to the end of the workday.
lines.style: Warm invitation with genuine brightness. Opening with easy hopefulness. Light, eager rhythm. The voice of someone ready to celebrate the small moment.
